offense_strengths: Explosive deep passing with big plays from Willis to Washington and Miller
Mobile QB Willis escaping pressure and extending plays
Run after catch ability from receivers like Washington and Douglas
Short yardage conversions with QB sneaks/tush push
defense_weaknesses: Struggled to stop SF run game in short yardage and goal line situations
Defenders losing assignments on motion and play action leading to big gains by Kittle and others
Missed tackles in open field allowing YAC
Vulnerable to deep middle passes and seam routes

offense_strengths: Effective use of play action and motion to create mismatches
Explosive YAC from Kittle and Samuel on passes over the middle
Versatile run game with McCaffrey and QB scrambles
Red zone efficiency with multiple TDs from short range
defense_weaknesses: Allowed MIA to convert multiple third downs and move the ball into scoring position
Gave up explosive deep pass play for a TD
Missed tackles on runs by Achane and Washington
